decisions.reason: As a newly launched flagship digital product with its own page and framed as a new product line, it fits the firm's core software business and the broader push toward digital workflows in practices.
A continuing education institute is adjacent to the core customer base and can strengthen client retention, but as a less central service offering it is somewhat more exposed if demand stays modest.
A remote screen sharing support tool closely supports the firm's installed software business and service model, so management would usually retain it unless usage proves clearly too low or redundant.
